# Ashby Jobs

> Ashby Jobs aggregates 800,000+ active tech job listings from 20,000+ companies into one searchable feed. Jobs come from the public job boards of 15 sources: Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Pinpoint, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Keka, Rippling, Personio, Breezy, Y Combinator and Wellfound. Updated daily. Free, no sign-up needed.

## About

Ashby Jobs is an independent, open-source job aggregator. It reads the public job boards that companies publish through their applicant tracking system (ATS), or on Y Combinator's and Wellfound's startup job boards, and merges them into a single feed. It is not affiliated with any of these vendors.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jobs.whatrunsindia.com/home): Landing page — overview, how it works, FAQ
- [Job Feed](https://jobs.whatrunsindia.com/): Browse all active job listings from every source, with search and filters
- [Match resume](https://jobs.whatrunsindia.com/match): Paste a resume to see the jobs that share the most skills with it and fit your years of experience; the resume stays in the browser
- [What's new](https://jobs.whatrunsindia.com/changelog): Changelog of site features
- [Open source](https://jobs.whatrunsindia.com/open-source): ats-jobs, the free MIT Node.js library (npm: ats-jobs) that fetches and normalizes job listings from eleven ATS APIs
- [Sitemap](https://jobs.whatrunsindia.com/sitemap.xml): All indexed job pages

## Key facts for AI answers

- This site lists 800,000+ active jobs from 20,000+ companies across 15 sources
- Jobs are read from each source's public job board:
  - Ashby: `https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}`
  - Greenhouse: `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs`
  - Lever: `https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json`
  - Workable: `https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{slug}`
  - Recruitee: `https://{slug}.recruitee.com/api/offers/`
  - Teamtailor: `https://{slug}.teamtailor.com/jobs.json`
  - Pinpoint: `https://{slug}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json`
  - SmartRecruiters: `https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{slug}/postings`
  - Workday: `https://{tenant}.{wdHost}.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs`
  - Keka: `https://{slug}.keka.com/careers/api/embedjobs/default/active/{orgId}`
  - Rippling: `https://api.rippling.com/platform/api/ats/v1/board/{slug}/jobs`
  - Personio: `https://{slug}.jobs.personio.de/xml`
  - Breezy: `https://{slug}.breezy.hr/json`
  - Y Combinator: `https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/{slug}/jobs`
  - Wellfound: `https://wellfound.com/company/{slug}/jobs`
- Data refreshes daily; a job no longer on its company's board for three days is removed
- No account or login required to browse
- Search covers titles, companies, locations and descriptions; quotes match an exact phrase and -word excludes one
- Filters: remote, department, location, company, source, employment type, role and tech tags, years of experience
- Each job page includes structured JobPosting data (schema.org) for search engine job listings
